scope: NatalNode Web pre-production operations and release engineering readiness

policy.publicRelease: PUBLIC_RELEASE=BLOCKED until every launch-blocking external gate is PASS and final certification is recorded
policy.authorityBoundary: This manifest describes Web release operations only. It does not admit Engine, astronomy, interpretation, My Chart, or public launch runtime behavior.

gates.description: Production runtime configuration, preflight, liveness, readiness, and fail-closed startup boundaries are implemented and covered.
gates.notes: External deployment must inject the complete production configuration and prove liveness/readiness after rollout.

gates.description: Forward-only PostgreSQL migrations, schema compatibility preflight, private database connectivity, and migration ownership are release boundaries.
gates.notes: A provisioned non-public PostgreSQL instance and a successful release migration are still external evidence.

gates.description: Backup ownership, restore target, verification steps, and abort conditions are defined without inventing RPO or RTO.
gates.notes: Backup system selection, retention configuration, restore drill, RPO, and RTO require owner evidence.

gates.description: The current process-local limiter is explicit and bounded; production traffic requires an admitted distributed or edge rate-limit authority.
gates.notes: No Redis, cloud limiter, threshold, or SLA is selected by this patch. A single replica is not treated as production distributed protection.

gates.description: Magic-link email uses the existing provider boundary and must receive a verified production sender, domain, callback origin, and secret through deployment configuration.
gates.notes: No live email is sent in this patch. Production must not use onboarding@resend.dev or local placeholder values.

gates.description: Email and Google authentication configuration, redirect ownership, one-time token use, session issuance, and generic failure behavior remain explicit.
gates.notes: The repository does not provision OAuth credentials or register a production callback. No new Google integration is added here.

gates.description: Secrets are deployment-injected, absent from Git, browser artifacts, diagnostics, logs, and generated runtime configuration.
gates.notes: Secret-manager selection, access policy, rotation, and recovery are external deployment responsibilities.

gates.description: Structured request observability exposes bounded operational signals without PII, credentials, tokens, cookies, request bodies, or database secrets.
gates.notes: A durable production sink, access controls, retention, and operator dashboard are not provisioned by this patch.

gates.description: Alert categories and ownership are defined separately from application logs; no threshold or notification SLA is invented.
gates.notes: Alert routing, thresholds, escalation contacts, and paging integration require external owner evidence.

gates.description: Application, database, external-provider, and policy-owned retention responsibilities are classified without making legal conclusions.
gates.notes: Final retention durations, legal holds, and policy approval remain owner decisions.

gates.description: Legal and public configuration dependencies are identified as launch work rather than inferred from code readiness.
gates.notes: This repository does not certify privacy notices, terms, regional policy, or regulatory obligations.

gates.description: The deployment must own the public HTTPS origin, certificate, DNS records, secure cookie boundary, and email-domain DNS records.
gates.notes: No DNS, TLS, Resend, or OAuth console operation is performed by this patch.

gates.description: Production Engine integration remains outside the Web operations gate and is explicitly fail-closed.
gates.notes: No Engine access is made. PROVIDER DECISION DEFERRED. Production Engine integration is not admitted.

gates.description: Astronomy/provider/scientific authority, configuration identity, and production fact provenance remain unselected and unadmitted.
gates.notes: PROVIDER DECISION DEFERRED. Development and research fixtures are not production astronomy evidence.

gates.description: A release owner must review code gates, external checklist evidence, rollback readiness, and all blocked authority gates before any public release decision.
gates.notes: The release check is deterministic automation, not a production certification or owner approval.

externalPrelaunchChecklist.item: Provision a private production PostgreSQL target, inject DATABASE_URL and SSL configuration, run the canonical migration, and retain migration output as release evidence.
Select backup ownership and execute a restore verification into a NON_PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_DATABASE target; record RPO/RTO only after owner decision.
Provide a distributed or edge rate-limit authority and prove that production traffic does not rely on one process-local limiter.
Provision the deployment secret owner, access policy, rotation path, and rollback access without placing credentials in Git, images, logs, or browser artifacts.
Verify the production email sender/domain and DNS records, configure the provider secret and callback origin, and reject onboarding@resend.dev and placeholders.
Complete the current Google authentication contract in the production console, including exact redirect URI, client credentials, secure cookie policy, and session verification.
Connect durable privacy-safe logs and alerts, assign operators, and verify failure signal delivery without logging PII, credentials, tokens, cookies, or chart data.
Approve retention classes, deletion/hold rules, legal configuration, public notices, and any region-specific release obligations.
Verify production DNS/TLS, one canonical public origin, secure host-only cookies, rollback routing, and liveness/readiness traffic gating.
Resolve PROVIDER DECISION DEFERRED and separately admit production Engine/scientific authority only through an approved contract and independent validation.
Record final release certification only after every launch-blocking item has evidence and the rollback/abort decision path is staffed.
